.²1 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Any condition which produces or develops a particular state
 of body or mind; (one of the three main divisions of {%Bhāvas%}, the
 other two being {#anuBAva#} and {#vyaBicAriBAva#} <ab>qq. vv.</ab>); {#ratyAdyudboDakA#}
 {#loke viBAvAH kAvyanAwyayoH#} <ls>S. D. 62</ls>; its chief subdivisions are {#Alambana#}
 and {#uddIpaka#}; see {#Alambana#}.
.²2 A friend, an acquaintance.
.²3 Any exciting circumstance (as dress <ab>&c.</ab>).
